description: This Java source file defines the PartyServices class within the OFBiz framework, containing numerous service methods to manage parties, persons, groups, affiliates, and related entities. It includes create, update, and lookup functions, as well as auxiliary services for adding notes and handling contact mechanisms. The code is part of a larger enterprise application focused on party and contact management, with methods supporting complex queries, entity creation, and status management.

methods.name: createPerson

methods.description: Updates the status of a party, ensuring the status change is valid and recording the change; disables user logins if party is disabled.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates person and party entities with provided data, optionally changing the status via a separate service call.

methods.name: createPartyGroup
methods.description: Creates a new party group, ensuring the partyId is unique and of type PARTY_GROUP.

methods.name: updatePartyGroup
methods.description: Updates existing party group and associated party entities.

methods.description: Creates a new affiliate entity linked to an existing party.
